QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Actinops
QuestInfo.0: Thorson seems like he has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Thorson explains that the creature that invaded the village was a mutated Actinops, a creature they used to fish for. It's normally completely transparent, but could have changed color if it ate something pink. He claims that if it was really an Actinops, then it will be weakest while it is regenerating.
